Seed material lives in `resources/SEROCK_NAME_LEXICON.md` and
`skills/jewish-onomastics.md`. Check there first — the case may already be recorded.

## The name

- Canonical / recorded form:
- Variant form(s) observed:
- Type: spelling variant · transliteration round-trip · OCR mangling · index convention

## Where it was observed

Source and context. An index, a memorial database display, a printed book, an
OCR output — say which, and say whether you saw it yourself.

## Is this a true variant, or a near-miss?

**This is the important field.** A near-miss that is actually a different family
must be recorded as ruled out, not as a variant — the lexicon already carries one
such case (`KANALEK`, a near-miss that is *not* Kanarek).

- [ ] True variant — same name, different rendering
- [ ] Ruled-out near-miss — looks close, is a different person or family
- [ ] Unresolved — genuinely unsure

If ruled out or unresolved, say what evidence settles it, or what would.

## Note

Variant proposals are additive. They never rewrite a literal recorded name.
